verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Entra ID supports passkeys (FIDO2) on security keys, native or third-party passkey providers, and Microsoft Authenticator, and Conditional Access can require MFA to reach specific apps. However, no cited doc shows a policy that requires FIDO2/passkeys specifically, as opposed to MFA generally. Community reports of a downgrade attack bypassing FIDO when fallback methods such as TAP stay enabled point to a real enforcement caveat. missing for 10: explicit evidence that policy can mandate phishing-resistant FIDO2/passkey methods per app, documentation on preventing fallback-method downgrade, independent hands-on confirmation of enforcement
